title: Binance Completes the Space ID Subscription Launchpad and Will Open Trading for ID
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has completed the subscription format Launchpad for Space ID  and the final token allocation results are now showing on the  Space ID Launchpad Page . A total of 103,598 participants committed 8,677,923.9471 BNB during the subscription period, representing an oversubscription of 1,170x.  5 participants reached the 600,000 ID hard cap, resulting in the participants’ allocation being passed down to the remaining users. For further information on how this is calculated, refer to a detailed guide  here . As a reference for users that participated: Users that committed 50 BNB received an allocation of 578.4411 ID and will have 0.04287406 BNB deducted. Users that committed 500 BNB received an allocation of 5,784.4115 ID, and will have 0.42874058 BNB deducted. Users that committed 5,000 BNB received an allocation of 57,844.1149 ID and will have 4.28740580 BNB deducted. The corresponding BNB tokens will be deducted from your already-locked BNB balance within 60 minutes of this announcement. Once deducted, your ID and remaining BNB tokens will both be transferred to your spot wallet. Binance will list Space ID (ID) in the innovation zone and open trading for ID/BTC, ID/USDT and ID/BNB trading pairs at  2023-03-22 12:00 (UTC) . Note: The token purchase price was set at 1 ID = 0.00007412 BNB or 0.025 USD (using a BNB price of 337.3 USD), as per the previous announcement  here .
